brief: A forehand metal-bat swing from the ready stance whose tip lands on the head of the standing target at about 2.07 s, with a swing a human arm can actually drive (the WEAPON judge) and nothing Check must fix.
notes: The bat is in the hand from the start. Fighter 2 stands where the reference's tip lands. The WEAPON judge (scripts/weapon_torque.gd) reads the torque the wrist and shoulder must give against measured human maxima (wrist 14.9 N m, shoulder 77.2 N m: docs/physics_constants.md) and wants a wind-up and a follow-through. 30 fps.

asserts.line: weapon tip touches fighter 2 head at 2.07 s +-6 f
weapon tip speed over 3 m/s at 2.07 s +-6 f
fighter 2 head at least 10 cm from fighter 1 weapon tip 0-1.5 s
